daily_focus_title_zh: 第 30 天：历史实测与未来预测跨时态衔接段（Historical vs. Projected Trends） × 成段后七维自检清单（The 7-Point Paragraph Audit Checklist） × AI_Mini_Paper 全篇梳理

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 历史实测与未来预测跨时态衔接段（Historical vs. Projected Trends）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 含未来预测年份的图表 / 产业算力与能耗预测报告
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [历史实测轨迹 Historical Trajectory (Past Tense)]：Between [2010] and [2025], global data-center electricity demand rose steadily from [200 TWh] to [460 TWh], driven by cloud migration.
S2 [当下转折与未来加速 Projected Acceleration (Projection Verbs)]：From [2026] onward, consumption is projected to accelerate sharply, with forecasts indicating a surge to [1,050 TWh] by [2035].

S3 [结构占比重塑 Structural Shift in Projections]：Within this projected expansion, generative AI training and inference—which accounted for less than [10%] in [2023]—are anticipated to represent over [45%] of total load by [2040].
S4 [条件式审慎收尾 Conditional Hedging]：Nevertheless, energy-efficient hardware adoption is expected to moderate the growth slope during the final five years.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Historical Past (rose/accounted for) -> Pivot Year -> Future Projection Verbs (is projected/anticipated/expected to) -> Moderating Factor. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L017.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: From 2010 to 2025, demand increased from 200 to 460. In 2035, it will increase to 1050. AI was 10% in 2023 and will be 45% in 2040.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 未来年份全部生硬使用 will be / will increase，违反学术图表报告对未来预测需使用审慎预测动词（is projected / anticipated / forecast to）的规范。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Between 2010 and 2025, global data-center electricity consumption more than doubled from 200 TWh to 460 TWh. From 2026 onward, total demand is projected to climb at a substantially steeper rate, with baseline forecasts pointing to 1,050 TWh by 2035. Within this expansion, AI model training and inference—which represented under 10% of server load in 2023—are anticipated to account for nearly half (46%) of total consumption by 2040. However, widespread deployment of sparsity-aware accelerators is expected to temper the annual growth rate after 2035.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 演讲幻灯片与复杂图表视觉引导段（Visual Signposting in Tech Talks）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在演讲到架构图或核心实验曲线（Slide 4 / Slide 7）时，用最自然的口语引导听众的眼睛先看哪、再看哪，瞬间读懂图表背后的胜出逻辑。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 学术演讲图表/架构讲解逐字稿（Visual Walkthrough）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [视觉坐标锁定 Spatial Pointer]：Let's look at the comparison in the right panel of Slide 5, where the horizontal axis tracks prediction horizon and the vertical axis shows MSE.
S2 [引导观察反方崩溃曲线 Guide to Baseline Curve]：Notice the dashed orange curve representing the standard Transformer baseline: past 336 steps, error shoots up almost vertically.
S3 [引导观察我方稳定曲线 Guide to Our Curve]：Now compare that with our solid blue curve at the bottom, which stays flat even out to 720 steps.
S4 [一句话点破视觉差距原因 One-Sentence Takeaway]：That gap comes directly from our neural-ODE scale tracker preventing long-range drift.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Spatial Coordinate -> Notice Baseline Failure -> Compare Our Curve -> One-Sentence Mechanistic Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L018, L015.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Here is Figure 3. You can see many lines here. Our model is the blue line and it is the lowest, which means our model is the best on all horizons.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 没有给听众任何坐标引导（You can see many lines here），听众还在找坐标轴是什么意思时你已经翻页了。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Let's focus on the right panel of Slide 6, which plots forecasting error as the prediction window stretches from 96 to 720 hours. Follow the dashed orange curve for iTransformer—notice how rapidly the error climbs once we pass 336 hours. Now compare that against our solid blue curve along the bottom, which remains nearly flat all the way to 720 hours. That 17% gap at the far right comes directly from decoupling phase attention from continuous scale tracking.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 托福综合写作 / 学术争议正反交锋段（Point-by-Point Reading vs. Lecture Synthesis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: TOEFL Integrated Writing 主体段 / 论文理论争议辨析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]：The reading passage contends that [Claim A], arguing that [Reading's Supporting Mechanism].
S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]：The lecturer directly challenges this assertion by pointing out that [Core Flaw / Neglected Factor in Reading's Premise].
S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit].
S4 [结论锁定 Refutation Closure]：Consequently, rather than achieving [Reading's Goal], the proposed measure actually exacerbates [Negative Outcome].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Reading Claim -> Lecturer's Direct Challenge -> Specific Counter-Mechanism -> Reversed Outcome. 绑定逻辑规则：L008, L019.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The reading says that replacing all delivery trucks with autonomous drones will save energy. The professor disagrees. She says drones use a lot of battery to stay in the air and can only carry one package at a time.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 句式碎片化（The reading says... The professor disagrees. She says...），缺乏紧凑的逻辑因果嵌套。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The reading passage contends that replacing urban delivery vans with autonomous quadcopter drones will substantially reduce last-mile transportation energy consumption, citing the lighter weight of aerial vehicles. The lecturer directly challenges this premise by examining energy efficiency per kilogram of delivered freight. Specifically, she points out that unlike ground vehicles supported passively by road surfaces, multi-rotor drones must expend continuous battery power simply to counteract gravity and headwinds while carrying only a single parcel per trip. Consequently, servicing a dense apartment block via individual drone flights consumes nearly three times more energy per package than a single consolidated van route.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 成段后七维自检清单（The 7-Point Paragraph Audit Checklist）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 写完或改完任何一个英语段落，必须依次用七把尺子过筛：① 首句是否一眼看清本段唯一核心主张？② 每句主语是否控制在 6–8 词以内（无头重脚轻）？③ 句与句之间是否遵循“旧信息在前、新信息在后”？④ 所有的 This/Such 后是否都跟了精准汇总名词？⑤ 是否彻底清除了口语词与 AI 套话？⑥ 所有的程度主张是否都有具体指标、基线或微观案例支撑？⑦ 主动与被动语态的切换是否服务于信息焦点？
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Audit(Para) = Unity(1) + ShortSubject(2) + GivenToNew(3) + SummaryNoun(4) + ZeroAI_ZeroColloquial(5) + ConcreteMetricOrCase(6) + PurposefulVoice(7).
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 写完只检查拼写和单复数，不检查段落骨架、信息流与论证闭环。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Checking only spelling and grammar while leaving a 22-word subject, bare 'This', and unsubstantiated 'very good performance' untouched.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Applying the 7-point audit systematically: compressing the 22-word subject to 4 words, replacing bare 'This' with 'This phase lag', and replacing 'very good' with 'a 14.6% MSE reduction on Weather'.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 将抽象的“改作文/改论文”转化为 7 个可逐项打勾的工程化核验动作。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 先让步、再釜底抽薪式反驳（Concession-Pivot-Refutation）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 无论是论文引言批评前人方法、Rebuttal 回复审稿人，还是六级/雅思大作文回应反方观点，最高级的说服力都来自“先承认对方在特定受限条件下确实有效（Concession），再指出该条件在真实/复杂场景下不成立（Pivot & Refutation）”。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Admittedly / While [Prior Method / Opposing View] achieves [Specific Merit] under [Strict Assumption A], this assumption breaks down when [Real-World Condition B], resulting in [Concrete Failure].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 一上来全盘否定前人工作（Previous works are totally wrong/useless），显得极不客观且容易激怒审稿人。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: MLP-based forecasters are too simple and cannot model complex dependencies, so our Transformer model is necessary.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While lightweight MLP forecasters achieve competitive accuracy on stationary sequences with stable periodicity, their fixed temporal weights cannot adapt dynamically when industrial sensor streams undergo abrupt regime shifts.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 先肯定 MLP 在平稳周期序列上的竞争力，再精准指出其“固定时间权重无法适应突发工况漂移”的结构性软肋，有理有据。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: From 2010 to 2025, demand increased from 200 to 460. In 2035, it will increase to 1050. AI was 10% in 2023 and will be 45% in 2040.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L030 成段后七维自检清单（The 7-Point Paragraph Audit Checklist））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 未来年份全部生硬使用 will be / will increase，违反学术图表报告对未来预测需使用审慎预测动词（is projected / anticipated / forecast to）的规范。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Between 2010 and 2025, global data-center electricity consumption more than doubled from 200 TWh to 460 TWh. From 2026 onward, total demand is projected to climb at a substantially steeper rate, with baseline forecasts pointing to 1,050 TWh by 2035. Within this expansion, AI model training and inference—which represented under 10% of server load in 2023—are anticipated to account for nearly half (46%) of total consumption by 2040. However, widespread deployment of sparsity-aware accelerators is expected to temper the annual growth rate after 2035.

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: CET-6 & IELTS Task 2 Technology & Society Essay
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想客观概括前人主流模型（如 Transformer / Diffusion / MLP）取得了什么进展，但点出它们共同依赖的一个脆弱前提假设。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Many researchers have studied this problem. Wu et al. used Autoformer. Nie et al. used PatchTST. They are very good, but they all think the data distribution does not change, which is wrong in real life.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L020 反事实假设论证法（Counterfactual Reasoning in Exam Essays））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: ① 流水账罗列人名（A used X, B used Y）；② 口语化严重（very good, think, which is wrong in real life）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Recent deep forecasters have substantially reduced long-horizon error by replacing point-wise attention with sub-series patch tokenization and frequency-domain decomposition. These architectures effectively capture recurring seasonal patterns when training and test sequences share stationary statistical moments. Yet they implicitly assume that inter-channel correlations and spectral energy distributions remain time-invariant across the prediction window. When external shocks alter underlying system dynamics, this stationarity assumption collapses, causing frozen spectral filters to project outdated trends.

focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写出整篇小论文的完整 Abstract（摘要）：在 150–180 词内一气呵成交代背景、核心痛点、方法机制与量化实验结果。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Time series imputation is very important in the era of big data. Existing generative models delve into the data distribution but are too slow and fail when missing rates are high. We propose FlowImp, a novel framework that uses conditional flow matching and frequency guidance. Extensive experiments show that FlowImp achieves state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 包含 in the era of big data, delve into, novel, state-of-the-art 等典型低质套话，且没有任何具体机制因果与量化数字。

第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Recovering missing sensor observations is essential for reliable downstream monitoring in industrial and clinical time series. While diffusion-based imputation models generate plausible trajectories under random missingness, they suffer from high sampling latency and lose global periodic coherence when entire sensor blocks drop out consecutively. We present FlowImp, a conditional flow-matching framework that reconstructs contiguous missing blocks in three ODE solver steps. Specifically, FlowImp anchors straight transport paths on observed spectral priors and enforces cross-channel phase consistency via a lightweight Fourier regularizer. Across six multivariate benchmarks under 50% block missingness, FlowImp reduces imputation MAE by 19.3% compared with CSDI while accelerating inference by 24x.
